basic_info.description: Blending timeless elegance with modern comfort in San Francisco's Ingleside district. This refined single-family home offers beautifully curated living space designed to elevate everyday living.  Main level features 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, including a sunlit primary ensuite with a beautifully updated bathroom. Open living and dining area is warm and inviting, complemented by modern finishes and plenty of natural light. The kitchen is a standout, with slim shaker cabinets, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, sleek modern fixtures, and a butlers pantry ready to inspire your inner chef. Throughout the home, enjoy new wide-plank flooring with fresh interior and exterior paint.  Lower level features 1 bedroom with a walk-in closet, 1 bathroom, and a cozy living area that offers great flexibility perfect for extended family, guests, or potential rental income. A spacious 1-car garage with interior access, ample storage, and a generously sized backyard ideal for outdoor entertaining, gardening, or simply relaxing in your own private space.  Just minutes from Whole Foods, 24 Hour Fitness, Ocean Avenue restaurants and shops, City College, and with easy access to Bart, Muni, and major freeways, this is urban convenience with a residential feel.
